reading: US rapper Don Toliver has moved two London shows to later dates.
An unknown substance, or type of material, was released into the crowd at his Manchester concert.
The people at the concert had to leave on Sunday.
The equipment is still in Manchester and cannot reach London in time for this week's shows.
The Wembley show will now be on 14 December.
The O2 show will now be on 15 December.
Police said 12,000 people had to leave the arena, a large building for events.
Police said 89 people had signs of illness after the concert.
Fans at the Manchester show will get all their ticket money back.

vocabulary.definition: After the day or time first planned.
A large group of people in one place.
The things people need to do a job.
A paper or phone message that shows you can enter an event.
